## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The linked issue is open and has `status:approved`.
- [ ] Exactly one PR type is selected and its matching `type:*` label is applied.
- [ ] The branch name follows `type/lowercase-description`.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Commits use Conventional Commit format and contain no attribution trailers.
- [ ] No secrets or unrelated changes are included.
